description: See which agent spawned which thread. A sidebar thread list where child threads nest under the thread that started them, at any depth, and a parent folds its subtree into one line that counts each state. Provider subagents (Claude Code Agent calls, Codex subagents) show as a counter on the parent's row with type, state, duration and tokens on hover. Threads group by project or status. Sort globally by last activity, creation date or status, with per-folder overrides; creation-date sorting keeps rows in place as messages arrive. Above them sit Recent Activity, your scheduled Automations and, with the GitHub Folder plugin installed, the pull requests that need you. Drag sections and project folders to reorder them. PR icons with numbers below each thread title show its branch's pull request state, checks and conflicts through bb's built-in GitHub PR Status plugin and the environment's gh login. With Thread Links installed, all PR links in session messages appear in a horizontally scrolling row. Reads thread data on the bb server; PR status comes from GitHub.
